: (i) PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted s taff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer along with all stat utory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. (ii) GST will be paid at actual on submission of valid GST Invoice certified by the contactor. After payment of GST, the firm may submit the challan copy to NADP as evidence of payment of GST. (iii) The vehicle will be hired on monthly package and it will be detailed based on "AS AND WHEN REQUIRE D BASIS" for day-to-day official requirement. (iv) Buyer will indicate the requirement and reporting time of vehicle around 12 hours before actual requir ement by telephone/Whatsapp or mail. Service provider has to provide vehicle as per requirement. The us age hours will be counted only for the duration vehicle was in use by NADP. (v) No. of vehicle required per day may vary between 00 to 10, as per actual requirement basis. (vi) Extra Kms and extra Hrs beyond 80 Kms X 10 Hrs service should be calculated on pro rata basis of "Da ily Vehicle Hiring Cost (per package) inclusive of GST and payment will be made as per terms and conditio ns mentioned in SLA of GeM. (vii) The registered address of the Firm/ Service Provider must be in Nagpur District only. The Service Provi der must submit documentary evidence in this regard. (viii) The bidder should accept the "Scope of Work" document uploaded with the bid document. (ix) The bidder should accept the "Buyer Added Bid Specific Terms & Conditions" and "Additional Terms & conditions" uploaded with the bid document. (x) The Service provider will be fully responsible for following all labour laws. (xi) If service provider provides higher version of vehicle in place of AC SEDAN then it will be acceptable b ut charge/ payment of the vehicle will be made as per Monthly package/Contract rate of AC SEDAN vehicle. (xii) Modified fuel vehicle from petrol to CNG/ Diesel to CNG is not acceptable. However, Company made C NG vehicle is acceptable subject to physical verification by NADP authority or competent authority. (xiii) The competent authority reserves the right to terminate the contract early, at own discretion, by prov iding a one month notice period to the contractor. (xiv) The toll charges & parking charges will be paid by the service provider and it will be reimbursed sepa rately by the Buyer to the Service Provider on actual basis, against receipt submitted by the Service Provid er. (xv) Cut-off date for considering the Past Experience of similar services (in years) will be the Bid Publicatio n Date. Additional Terms and Conditions: (i) No Near Relative Clause: The Bidder has to submit commitment to the following clause: "The bidder cer tifies that none of his/her near relative is working in Munitions India Limited (MIL) as defined below. In ca s e of proprietorship firm certificate will be given by the proprietor. For partnership firm certificate will be gi ven by all the partners and in case of limited company by all the Directors of the company excluding Gover nment of India / Financial institution nominees and independent non Official part time Directors appointed by Govt. of India or the Governor of the state and full time Directors of PSUs both state and central. Due to any breach of these conditions by the company or firm or any other person, the bid will be canceled and Bi d Security amount will be forfeited at any stage whenever it is noticed and MIL will not pay any damage to the company or firm or the concerned person. The company or firm or the person can also be debarred for further participation in MIL's Tenders. The near relatives for this purpose are defined as: A) Members of a Hindu undivided family. B) They are husband and wife.

C) The one is related to the other in the manner as father, mother, grandparents and maternal grandparen ts, son(s) & Son's wife (daughter-in-law), Daughter(s) and daughter's husband (son-in-law), brother(s) and brother's wife, sister(s) and sister's husband (brother-in-law). D) The one is related to the other in the manner as sister-in-law (husband's sister), brother-in-law (Wife's br other), father-in-law and mother-in-law. E) The one is related to the other as child by blood, adoption or marriage with whom the child is living, who assume primary responsibility for the child's care." (ii) NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE: The Bidder has to submit commitment to the following clause: I, M/s. hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, specification, plan, desi gn, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing rules. Signature with seal. (iii) Documents to be submitted: As per the GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC 4.0 VERSION 1.5) cla use No. 4 (xiii) (g) "The participation by the Seller in e-bidding shall be construed as his / her acceptance f or all the Terms and Conditions as outlined in the e-bidding including GTC, STC and ATC. However, the Buy er shall have right to decide the technical and commercial acceptability of the individual bids based on elig ibility criteria and compliance as stipulated in the bid document." In accordance, the Bidder shall submit th e 'Scope of Work', 'Buyer added Terms & conditions' & 'Additional Terms & Conditions' duly signed with fir m's seal and stamp, as a commitment to provide service strictly as per Buyer's 'Scope of Work' and by foll owing the Buyer's 'Terms & Conditions'. . 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider
